notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.10 Notes: Thursday, February 23rd
notes.notes:
Tomorrow we will be saying goodbye to Early Access and officially launch The Golf Club VR. It’s been an amazing run, and we’ve had a blast engaging with our community and watching our game take shape with all of your help! We’re extremely proud of what we’ve accomplished, and we owe much of what this game is to all of you who supported us over the past 4.5 months with feedback, feature suggestions, and bug reports. 

Thank You!

Now that we are leaving Early Access, we’ve closed the Beta Branch and released the most performant version of TGCVR to date with this update.

Official Release Update:
•Performance has been significantly improved – High End rigs should now be able to max out TGCVR with little to no hitching at all.
•The leaderboards and ghost ball servers have been wiped. Now’s the time to try to get to the top of the leaderboards!
•Swing speed spikes caused by tracking and framerate issues should now be significantly reduced. 
•Fixed all of the text issues on Scoreboards, in the Settings, and in the ProTee Simulator that were present on the Beta Branch.

Known Issues
•Oculus – Steering the golf cart with two active controllers requires both thumbsticks to be rotated at the same time. (investigating a fix)
•Oculus – Reverse in the golf cart rarely works. (investigating a fix)

We will continue to provide some support for critical fixes and minor performance changes over the next couple weeks. However, this will mark the end of feature development though and we look forward to seeing what the future brings.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.09 Notes: Wednesday, February 8th
notes.notes:
Many long awaited changes are making their way into our builds with this update, that’s right, I said builds. First off, we have finally got our hands on Oculus Touch and addressed many of the issues plaguing the Oculus Community in TGCVR. We have also reworked the tutorial for any new Touch users who make their way to the game moving forward. 

In other notable news, we also have a Beta branch available for you to test out. This includes a version of TGCVR on par with the new update with an engine upgrade to Unity 5.5. The reason we are putting this out as a Beta for now is to get it in your hands a little early. There are still some bugs due to the upgrade and optimizations to take place in order to get the full affect. However we feel that it’s in a good spot now to let you experience what we have been working on.

[b][I]Testing the Beta [/I][/b]
To install the beta you will need to use the following steps:
•	Select The Golf Club VR in your Steam Library and right click on the name.
•	In the popup menu you will want to select Properties.
•	In the Properties window you will want to select the Betas tab along the top menu.
•	There will be a dropdown menu to select the beta “tgcvr-beta”.
•	The update will proceed automatically.
We encourage everyone to try out the beta build and share your experience with us on the forums whether you see improvements or have issues with the build. 

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Oculus Touch [/I][/b]
Many of this issues reported on the forums have been addressed. We have also gone the step further to update the tutorial for new and existing Touch users.

[b][I]Ball Locators [/I][/b]
We have added a ball locator while driving the golf cart to help you find it along your travels. 

[b][I]Putting Weights [/I][/b]
Due to issues with green speeds we have added and option for those who are having issues putting. You can now select the weight of your putter to help with your control on the green. The heavier your putter, more force will be required to get you to the hole.

[b][I]Final Club Tunings [/I][/b]
Craig has completed a final pass at our clubs and has addressed a handful of issues that have been reported. Playing onto the green is much more manageable now and you should see a more realistic result to punch and flop shots.

[b][I]Miscellaneous [/I][/b]
•         Hex Buttons now display tooltips while pointing at them.
•         Shot grade contact % bug has been addressed.
•         Golf cart seat orientation has been fixed.
•         We have added a seatbelt button to the golf cart that prevents you from being ejected.
•         Golf cart physics tunings. The bouncing/rocking/tipping has been severely reduced.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.08 Notes: Wednesday, January 25th
notes.notes:
Lots of changes this week with the new TGCVR patch. We have added two new features that we’re excited to start getting feedback on. In this update you will now be able to use the Pro Tee Simulator to take various shots from one location with ease. We are also welcoming the addition of drivable golf carts! In addition to these two new features we have also added a couple small things to improve the quality of your experience.

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Pro Tee [/I][/b]
In the lighthouse on Tutorial Island, there is now a Pro Tee Simulators open for use. With this addition you can now take shots from various driving, chipping and putting locations to hone your golf skills all while staying put.

[b][I]Golf Carts [/I][/b]
If you find a golf cart on a course, chances are you can now get in it and burn around. By teleporting to the driver seat of the cart you are locked in and ready to go. Using the touch pad to steer and trigger to gas, you now have the freedom to explore each course like never before.

[b][I]Controller Callouts [/I][/b]
To help out with new users and keep the games controls fresh in everyone’s minds. We have added UI callouts to the controller labeling each buttons action. These can be turned off at any time through the gameplay settings.

[b][I]Club Offset for Custom Peripherals [/I][/b]
In gameplay setting you now have a slider available to you that will allow you to adjust how the clubs line up with the controller. This addition allows you to reposition the club to fit the offset of various peripherals that we have seen the community present to us.

[b][I]Situational Club Suggestions [/I][/b]
Before each shot you will notice a club in your golf bag with a green highlight. This is the club suggestion based on the current lie and your performance with each individual club. The more you play the better the club suggestions will be. This feature can be disabled in the gameplay settings.  

[b][I]Rival Beacons[/I][/b]
Locating and navigating to an opponents ball has been a challenge to date, especially when trying to play live-asynchronous multiplayer with a friend. Now simply holding telepointer button (right on the trackpad) for a moment will display a beacon above each of your Rival opponents balls. To teleport directly to an opponents ball, simply aim the telepointer at the beacon and release the trackpad. This will make playing a structured round of golf with your buddies a much smoother experience.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.07 Notes: Wednesday, January 11th
notes.notes:
The past two weeks we have been putting a lot of focus on the gameplay physics and club tuning based on community feedback. With this update you’re going to see a big difference in the way the ball lands and rolls on the greens. We have addressed the issue of the ball shooting backwards with back spin and stopping abruptly, you should also see better bounces. We have also made individual tuning to each club for Casual and Amateur difficulties.  

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Addressed clipping issues with the range finder.
•Addressed crashes that were reported by users.
•Addressed issues progressing through the tutorial
•Replaced missing textures so there should be no more pink boxes.

[b][I]Additional Courses [/I][/b]
With this update we have started to bring all The Golf Club 1 courses over to The Golf Club VR. This is a long process and over the next several hours you will continue to see new courses be populated to the game. At the time of this update there should be at least a few thousand new ones to keep you busy for a while. Once this update is fully completed we will be setting up to pull any new courses from The Golf Club 1 in to The Golf Club VR. At that point, if you own the original game you will be able to create your own courses then play them in VR.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.06 Notes: Wednesday, December 14th
notes.notes:
Patch 1.06 will be our will be our last update for 2016. Our team has been working very hard to bring some exciting new features to The Golf Club VR over the past couple months and it’s time for a break. In the New Year we will bring the patches back mid-January with a couple new and exciting features that we think everyone will be happy to get their hands on. We want to thank everyone for the amazing support and feedback that has been provided so far. We look forward to hearing your thoughts on the latest patch and with what’s to come in 2017.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Putt preview can no longer be sent from ghost balls.
•The contact for putting feedback has been fixed.
•Ghost ball name tags will no longer obstruct your view on the green.
•Fixed an issue with player score not showing up at the end of a round against ghost balls.
•Adjusted golf club lengths.

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Live Ghost Balls [/I][/b]
Live Ghost Balls have been added with this patch! You are now able to join any of your Steam friends during their round on any of the available courses. When selecting a course and choosing Rivals there is now a Friends (Live) filter that allows you to join any in-progress rounds. We encourage everyone to reach out in the community and create some networks of folks to play with. There are a lot of active players out there that I’m sure would enjoy a round with you or a group.

[b][I]Range Finder [/I][/b]
We have added a range finder to the Vive controller that allows you to zoom in on the terrain around you. To use this feature simply lift the Vive controller to your eye and look through the top opening of the controller. This will magnify everything in this viewport. There is a reticule to help pick your target and you can lock the information displayed at any point by pulling the trigger. There is also an option to increase the magnification by pressing up on the touchpad while looking through the viewport. This feature can come in handy when trying to locate the pin from a distance or determine how far away you are from a hazard.

[b][I]Gameplay Settings Overhaul [/I][/b]
With the increased need for gameplay settings we have adjusted the UI to allow for more options to help you customize the way you play The Golf Club VR. In addition to the new look we have added options to play without a stroke limit and to turn on mulligans. When playing with mulligans you are able to retake shots from its original location as often as you like without penalty. If you take a shot and don’t like the result, simple gab a ball from your golf bag and drop it in the circle drop zone. Note that as soon as a mulligan is played your scorecard will be removed from the server but you can still play live with your friends.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.05 Notes: Wednesday, November 30th
notes.notes:
Over the past two weeks we have put a lot of focus on improving Rivals and adding shot feedback to putting. With the Rivals improvement you can now see the ghost balls of the users you have selected to play against. Putt feedback can be seen after completing a practice putt or after your actual shot to breakdown the swing and give you a grade. We have also added 25 additional courses from the original TGC and enabled the option to favorite courses. 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Adjusted the angles that the watch appears to improve visibility of it.
•Addressed issues with grabbing a new ball just as the stroke limit has been reached.
•Club faces will now switch properly when changing handedness.
•Selecting favorite during the rate course screen now has an indication to show the course has been favorited.
•Putt preview will no longer be sent if you swing overtop of your actual ball.
•Reduced hitching issues when golf bag and ball are in view of HMD.
•Dropping a ball onto your golf bag no longer flags your scorecard for cheating.

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Ghost Balls [/I][/b]
While we continue to improve on Rivals for TGCVR we have added Ghost Balls with patch 1.05. Now when selecting to play against Rivals you will see each of the selected players shots with each stroke that you take throughout your round.

[b][I]Putt Feedback [/I][/b]
Similar to shot feedback leading up to the green, we have added specific grading feedback to the watch for putting. The watch feedback will breakdown the weight and tempo of your swing to give you an overall grade. To view your putt grade hold down on the trackpad after your shot and view your watch.

[b][I]Additional Courses [/I][/b]
With this update we have pulled in 25 additional courses from The Golf Club. These courses can be selected by going to the course select screen and selecting all courses, the hex button with three lines in it. With this addition we have also added the ability to favorite course as well. Courses can be favorited by selecting the option at the end of your round, or you can select the star on the course details screen of each course. To view the courses that you have chosen as favorites you can select the hex button with the star icon on the course select screen.

notes.title: TGCVR Final Release Date Update
notes.notes: Over the past five months, The Golf Club VR team has been hard at work in the effort to provide the best golfing experience on the HTC Vive. We are currently on track with our original goals of the project and believe we have delivered a great experience, as supported by all the positive reviews we’ve been receiving for which we are very much appreciative. Throughout development and Early Access on Steam, we have received a lot of positive and constructive feedback from our community to help us get to the point we are now. This also helped us realize that there is still more we can do with The Golf Club VR to continue improving that experience. With that in mind, we have decided to move the full release date of The Golf Club VR from December 2016 to early February 2017. We will use this additional time to continue to fine tune our gameplay mechanics, improve optimizations as well as add a couple of highly requested features from the community. We will of course in the meantime continue to provide updates for all those who are supporting us during this exciting phase.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.04 Notes: Wednesday, November 15th
notes.notes:
Let the competition begin! Phase one of asynchronous gameplay has been implemented. Each course now has a Rival select flow which allows you to browse your friends and other community members completed rounds. Select who you would like to play against or alongside before starting your round. Rival scores update on the scoreboard along with you as you complete each hole. In addition to Rivals we have also added stat tracking per difficulty which is displayed on the back of the yardage book. After each round is completed you can see your individual stats based on the difficulty you’re currently playing on. To try and keep the game fair for everyone we have added some anti-cheating checks to keep the Rivals list honest. If you are caught cheating during your round the hole will be marked on your scoreboard and the round will not be posted once it’s been completed.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Clearing local save data and then resuming saved course leaves watch/pointer/menu disabled
•If user switches controllers without restarting the game, the new controller will not display shot grades.
•Add the green speeds to the putter info pop up instead of surface penalty, when on the green.
•The practice putt on Pro flashes in when putting beside the ball.
•Interactions between golf balls and clubs and the bag cause the bag to fall over.
•The ball can bounce off of the users pocket after being hit.
•The watch breaks after losing tracking with the headset.

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Rivals [/I][/b]
With the addition of Rivals you will now be able to compete against scores posted by your friends and other community members. With the option to select up to 3 Rivals per-round you will see their scores update alongside yours after each hole. A few things that you need to know about Rivals:
•All available courses now have a Rivals button that you can select before beginning your round.
•When viewing Rivals the difficulty of each submitted scorecard is displayed with the users name and score.
•You are free to compete against any scorecard regardless of the difficulty you have chosen. 
•Only completed scorecards will be posted to the Rival list.
•Scorecards that have been caught cheating will not be posted to the Rival lists. You are free to play how you enjoy the game however we want to keep a fair balance to the posted scores.

[b][I]Stat Tracking [/I][/b]
In-game stats can now be viewed on the back of the yardage book. The stats that are displayed are based off the set difficulty that you have chosen through the settings. You can switch between difficulties freely do view your stats with each one. Only completed rounds will add to the accumulation of your in-game stats.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.04 Notes: Wednesday, November 15th
notes.notes:
Let the competition begin! Phase one of asynchronous gameplay has been implemented. Each course now has a Rival select flow which allows you to browse your friends and other community members completed rounds. Select who you would like to play against or alongside before starting your round. Rival scores update on the scoreboard along with you as you complete each hole. In addition to Rivals we have also added stat tracking per difficulty which is displayed on the back of the yardage book. After each round is completed you can see your individual stats based on the difficulty you’re currently playing on. To try and keep the game fair for everyone we have added some anti-cheating checks to keep the Rivals list honest. If you are caught cheating during your round the hole will be marked on your scoreboard and the round will not be posted once it’s been completed.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Clearing local save data and then resuming saved course leaves watch/pointer/menu disabled
•If user switches controllers without restarting the game, the new controller will not display shot grades.
•Add the green speeds to the putter info pop up instead of surface penalty, when on the green.
•The practice putt on Pro flashes in when putting beside the ball.
•Interactions between golf balls and clubs and the bag cause the bag to fall over.
•The ball can bounce off of the users pocket after being hit.
•The watch breaks after losing tracking with the headset.

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Rivals [/I][/b]
With the addition of Rivals you will now be able to compete against scores posted by your friends and other community members. With the option to select up to 3 Rivals per-round you will see their scores update alongside yours after each hole. A few things that you need to know about Rivals:
•All available courses now have a Rivals button that you can select before beginning your round.
•When viewing Rivals the difficulty of each submitted scorecard is displayed with the users name and score.
•You are free to compete against any scorecard regardless of the difficulty you have chosen. 
•Only completed scorecards will be posted to the Rival list.
•Scorecards that have been caught cheating will not be posted to the Rival lists. You are free to play how you enjoy the game however we want to keep a fair balance to the posted scores.

[b][I]Stat Tracking [/I][/b]
In-game stats can now be viewed on the back of the yardage book. The stats that are displayed are based off the set difficulty that you have chosen through the settings. You can switch between difficulties freely do view your stats with each one. Only completed rounds will add to the accumulation of your in-game stats.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.03 Notes: Wednesday, November 9th
notes.notes:
For this patch we have focused mainly on bug fixing and adding the ability to save and resume rounds. You are now able to post scorecards to the server if you have an internet connection. A round can be saved for each course available and the latest round posted will always be available through the course select flow.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•The first putt on the putt preview slide of the tutorial will show up now.
•Yards on the watch will now reset properly.
•Yards on the watch will now update with each shot.
•Should no long see feet displayed as units when off the green.
•Returning to the tutorial island all objects are now placed properly.
•TGC VR should no longer crash when adjusting the visual settings.
•Club flexibility descriptions have been added to help select the correct setting.

[b]New and Updated Features:[/b]
[b][I]Club Tunings for all Difficulties [/I][/b]
Casual and Beginner are on par when it comes to boost and assists. We have reduced the amount of boost received at the higher end of the swing speed. Pro has also been tuned/fixed, there was a bug stopping clubs from achieving their proper distance based on the club speed. You should be seeing more realistic distances than before when playing on Pro. Amateur has found a middle ground between Casual and Pro.

[b][I]Saving and Resuming [/I][/b]
If you have a network connection you can now save and resume your rounds. In progress scorecards for each available course will be available to be resumed. Upon starting the game your latest round will be accessible directly from the course details screen when selecting a course. Upon selecting to play a new course any previous save data will be removed from the server and your new round will begin to save.

[b][I]Reordered Tutorial [/I][/b]
The tutorial has been re-ordered to flow better with the new additions from the previous patch. We have also added more of a breakdown to the watch tutorial to help better identify its functionality. 

[b][I]Unlocked Two Additional Courses[/I][/b]
We have added two new nine hole courses and updated the Casuals Country Club, it's now a tropical island.

notes.title: TGC:VR Patch 1.02 Notes: Wednesday, November 2nd
notes.notes:
For this patch we wanted to focus on the feedback we have received from the community on the difficult learning curve of The Golf Club VR. In an effort to increase accessibility without taking away from golf, we have added a new beginner difficulty. This can both be used as a way to familiarize yourself with the controls of the game or can be a nice practice aid while you’re warming up before a round. Along with the new difficulty we have also added a putt preview feature that allows you to take a practice putt before lining up that 15ft eagle, or a double bogie. This by no means makes your putt a gimmie but helps you adjust to the green speeds and slope without jeopardizing your putting game. These features are among several other bug fixes and new features listed below. Take some time to play through the new tutorial and checkout the changes we have made. If you have any feedback or come across any issues, as always, we’re keeping an eye on the forums to help you out.

Bug Fixes:
•	Ball not being set properly when teleporting to ball on tutorial island.
•	Reduced the flash to steam room when grabbing the yardage book.
•	Scorecard not showing up properly on the scoreboard.
•	UI Sounds FX not working on menus.
•	Yellow ball beacon didn’t disappear after dropping a new ball.
•	Watch visibility range adjusted to fix issues with it popping in and out.
•	Sticky Club description is backwards and doesn’t fit in text box.
•	Missed swing feedback lines when making contact with the ball.
•	Default club rotations are not correct.
•	Watch showing feet instead of yards and not tracking strokes.
•	Localization for EFIGS, PT and JA. (First Pass)

Additional Features:

[b][I]Beginner difficulty with additional assists for aiming has been added. [/I][/b] This difficulty will be accessible through the tutorial or the gameplay settings via the main menu. This setting will give you visual assist to help aim your shots and apply the correct loft. This can be used to help line up your shot or you can lock in your swing by pressing up on the touch pad. While the direction is locked take a swing like normal to have the ball follow your selected path. 

[b][I]Receive a putt preview while on the green. [/I][/b] You can now take a step back and take a practice putt next to your ball. This will shoot your practice ball along the green to help you judge the weight of your shot and the slope of the green. Only one practice putt can be used per-stroke and this feature is not available on Pro.

[b][I]The shot analyzer has received an upgrade with additional shot information. [/I][/b] While viewing the shot analyzer you can now look at your watch to see how far your ball has travelled. In addition to this you will also receive a grade based on your swing speed, flight path, contact with the ball and the accuracy of your shot. The idea of the grading is to help improve your game by seeing where you’re getting penalized and try to improve on that area.

[b][I]The tutorials have been updated to outline the new features and difficulty.[/I][/b] You can now practice in the tutorial with each difficulty before moving on and without needing to open the menu. A putt preview tutorial has also been added.

[b][I]Ball depth in bunkers and the sand penalty are now based on how the ball enters the bunker. [/I][/b]

[b][I]MSAA and SS sliders have been added to the visual settings. [/I][/b]

[b][I]Unlocked two additional courses[/I][/b]

notes.title: Bug fixes and Sticky Clubs.
notes.notes:
We have to thank the community for the great feedback we have been receiving over our first week of Early Access. We have taken note of a lot of the issues and tweaks that need to be made leading up to full release and we look forward to pushing out new updates. The first request from the community was “Sticky Clubs” and here is your chance to get a hold of them! Along with two additional courses being unlocked. You can now open the gameplay menu and choose to play with “Sticky Clubs” on or off.

Bug Fixes:

•	SteamVR screenshots have been fixed, no more white images.
•	Clubs no longer fall through the ground on Tutorial Island.
•	Drop-zone issues have been address and illegal drops can now be played.
•	.exe has been changed from golf.exe to golfvr.exe
•	Tutorial crash while picking up driver has been fixed.

New Additions:

•	Unlocked 2 additional courses and replaced Finland Project.
•	Sticky Clubs have been added to gameplay settings.

notes.title: The Golf Club: VR Release Note
notes.notes:
The Golf Club VR is finally here! We are pleased to be able to bring the award winning golf game The Golf Club to the HTC Vive for Early Access. In the initial release we’re opening up several of the core features that have been implemented as well as three 18-hole courses and one 9-hole mini putt. As we progress through Early Access we encourage feedback from the community to help us improve the golf experience we’re providing.

With the initial Early Access release you can expect access to the following features.
•	Interactive Tutorial that teaches users how to play TGC:VR.
•	Interactive Golf Bag, complete with a full set of clubs and ball pocket.
•	1 to 1 motion controls offer the most realistic golf gameplay to date.
•	5 different levels of club flexibility.
•	4 sets of club lengths.
•	Left and Right handed clubs.
•	A yardage booklet for a top down view of the hole you’re on.
•	A golf watch with crucial shot information.
•	Swing feedback that displays your swing in 3D space to help you improve your game.
•	3 difficulty levels offer accessibility for all skill levels.
•	3 beautiful 18-hole courses and a 9-hole mini-putt course hand selected for VR.
•	 Roomscale Orientation to significantly reduce Vive cable interference.
•	Interactive objects.
•	Unique haptic feedback per club.
•	All new 3D audio throughout.

Leading up to our first patch release we would like to address the community feedback that we see will have a positive impact to the gameplay experience and performance. If you experience any issues feel free to contact us through the Steam forums or the Official TGC VR forums (http://www.hb-studios.com/forum/index.php?board=64.0). When reporting bugs or performance issues please include the specifications of the hardware you’re running The Golf Club VR on.
